note: Android screens with no counterpart in the iOS probe baseline. They have no page contract (there is nothing to extract), so this file is their explicit registration; a screen that is neither here nor in a contract is an `unmapped-android-screen` failure. Each entry names the evidence that the baseline really lacks the page.

screens.reason: iOS deleted its complete-Web surface (495da9b5 'Remove the app's complete-Web surface'): no `struct WebSurfacePage` is left, RootView.swift renders NativeShell unconditionally, and WebKit survives only as a 2-pt invisible anchor. Android still ships a full-screen Web host route, so there is no iOS page structure to mirror.
screens.evidence: git show --stat 495da9b5 (deletes examples/probe-app/PhoneDSHProbe/WebSurfacePage.swift); grep -rn 'struct WebSurfacePage' examples/probe-app -> no match; RootView.swift:9 `NativeShell()`
